title: GdprProcessingActivity
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — records of processing activities under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Article 30 requires controllers and processors to maintain records of processing activities under their responsibility. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Article 30(1)-(2).

recordsMaintained.description: Whether records of processing activities are maintained in writing (including electronic form). Source: GDPR Art 30(3).

controllerNameRecorded.description: Whether the name and contact details of the controller (and joint controller, representative, DPO where applicable) are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(a).

processingPurposesRecorded.description: Whether the purposes of processing are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(b).

dataCategoriesRecorded.description: Whether the categories of data subjects and personal data are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(c).

recipientCategoriesRecorded.description: Whether the categories of recipients (including third countries/international organisations) are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(d).

transfersRecorded.description: Whether transfers to third countries and documentation of suitable safeguards are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(e).

retentionPeriodsRecorded.description: Whether envisaged time limits for erasure of different categories of data are recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(f).

securityMeasuresDescribed.description: Whether a general description of technical and organisational security measures is recorded. Source: GDPR Art 30(1)(g).

recordContentsComplete.description: Whether the record contains all elements required by Art 30(1)(a)-(g) for controllers or Art 30(2)(a)-(d) for processors.
